content: Yahu idweř d ajeǧid x Israil
Xenni anabi Ilicaɛ iřaɣa-dd i yijjen zeg ayt n inabiyyen, inna as: “Byes, ksi aɣarraf-a n zzect deg ufus nnec uca tuyured ɣar Ramut di Jilɛad.
Xmi dinni i ɣa tawḍed, arzu x Yahu, mmis n Yahucafaṭ, mmis n Nimci. Adef ɣares uca ejj i-t ad dd-ikkar zi řwesṭ n yaytmas, ndeh i-t ɣar ijj n wexxam iṭṭurfiy mliḥ.
Xenni ksi aɣarraf n zzect, zeǧeɛ i-t x uzeǧif nnes uca ini: ‘Ammu i iqqar SIDI: Necc dehneɣ cek d ajeǧid x Israil.’ Xenni arzem tawwart, arweř, war ttriji ɛad ktar!”
Aḥudri, amsexxar n unabi, yuyur deg webrid ɣar Ramut di Jilɛad.
Umi din dd-yiweḍ, xzar, ikumandaren n řɛeskar tuɣa qqimen dinni. Netta inna: “Necc ɣari ijj n wawař i cek, a řqebṭan. Yahu isseqsa: “I man wen zzayneɣ marra?” Netta inna: “I cek, a řqebṭan!”
Xenni ikkar Yahu, yudef ɣar taddart. U netta ifarreɣ as zzect x uzeǧif nnes, inna as: “Ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Necc dehneɣ cek d ajeǧid x řgens n SIDI, x Israil.
Cek ad tewted taddart n Axab, sidi nnec, u necc ad ttareɣ zeg ufus n Izabil idammen n imsexxaren inu, inabiyyen, uřa d idammen n marra imsexxaren n SIDI.
Marra taddart n Axab ad tᵉttwakkes, u Necc ad qḍiɣ zi taddart n Axab marra wi t itteggen x řḥiḍ, am wenni ittwaṭṭfen, am wenni umi jjin di Israil.
Necc ad arreɣ taddart n Axab amecnaw taddart n Yarubɛam, mmis n Nabaṭ, u am taddart n Baɛca, mmis n Axiya.
Iṭan ad ccen Izabil deg iyyar n Yazraɛil uca war ittiři uřa d ijj wenni tt i ɣa ineḍřen.” Xenni yarzem netta tawwart uca yarweř.’”
Umi dd-iffeɣ Yahu ɣar barra ɣar imsexxaren n sidis, nnan as: “Aqa cek mliḥ? Mayemmi i ɣarek dd-yusa ubuhaři-ya?” Netta yarra-dd xasen: “Kenniw tessnem aryaz d řhard nnes!”
Maca nitni nnan “D ixarriqen, ini aneɣ t!” xenni inna: “Ammu d wammu i kidi issiweř, inna: ‘Ammu i iqqar SIDI: Necc dehneɣ cek d ajeǧid x Israil.’”
Řexdenni qeǧqen u kuř ijj iksi arruḍ nnes uca issars i-t sadu iḍaren nnes x tareddifin n ddruj uca suḍen deg uyicc n icarri, nnan: “Yahu d ajeǧid!”
Yahu, mmis n Yahucafaṭ, mmis n Nimci, igga ijj n řɛahd ḍidd Yuram. Yuram, netta jmiɛ ak-d marra Israil, tuɣa iḥḍa x Ramut di Jilɛad arendad n wudem n Ḥazayil, ajeǧid n Aram.

Maca ajeǧid Yuram yareggʷeḥ-dd, maḥend ad yarzu di Yazraɛil agenfu zeg iyezzimen i d as tuɣa ggin ayt n Aram, umi immneɣ ak-d Ḥazayil, ajeǧid n Aram. Yahu inna: “Mařa kenniw tᵉttafqem, xenni war ttejjim ad yarweř uřa d ijj zi tendint, ad yuyur maḥend ad issiweḍ řexbar-a ɣar Yazraɛil.”
Řmewt n ujeǧid Yuram d ujeǧid Ahazya d tjeǧidt Izabil
Xenni inya deg ukarru nnes, indeh ɣar Yazraɛil, maɣar dinni i tuɣa Yuram. Axazya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, tuɣa ihwa-dd, ḥima ad issijj x Yuram.

Aɛessas ibedd x ṣṣumɛet di Yazraɛil uca iẓra Yahu yusa-dd, inna: “Necc ttwařiɣ ijj n uhimur.” Xenni inna Yuram: “Awi-dd ijj n bu-uyis uca ssekk i-t-i-dd i umsagar akidsen, ad yini: “Ma d řehna min xef dd-tusid?”

Bu-uyis inya, ḥima ad t iřqa, inna: “Ammu i iqqar ujeǧid: ‘Ma d řehna min xef dd-tusid?’” Maca Yahu yarra-dd xas: “Mani cek icqa řehna? As-dd ɣar ḍeffar inu.” Aɛessas iɛřem aya, inna: “Amsexxar yiweḍ ɣarsen, maca war dd-iɛqib ca.”
Issekk ujeǧid ijj n bu-uyis wiss tnayen. Umi dd-yusa wanita ɣarsen, inna: “Ammu i iqqar ujeǧid: ‘Ma d řehna min xef dd-tusid?’” Maca Yahu yarra-dd xas: “Mani cek icqa řehna. As-dd ɣar ḍeffar inu.”
Aɛessas iɛřem s man aya ɛawed: “Netta yiweḍ i-ten, maca war dd-iɛqib ca u mammec ineddeh ayis, igga am mammec ittegg Yahu, mmis n Nimci, maɣar netta ineddeh am ineddeh ijj n ubuhaři.”

Xenni inna Yuram: “Ḥezzem akarru!” Ḥezzmen akarru nnes u Yuram, ajeǧid n Israil, iffeɣ ak-d Axazya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, nedhen kuř ijj akarru nnes. Nitni ffɣen i umsagar ak-d Yahu uca ufin t ɣar yeyyar n Nabut, Ayazraɛili.
Imsar umi iẓra Yuram Yahu, inna: “Ma d řehna i xef dd-tusid, a Yahu?” Maca wanita yarra-dd: “Mana řehna-ya min ɣa yekk farq-ccɣeř n yemmac Izabil d tseḥḥarin nnes ammu s waṭṭas?”
Inneqřeb Yuram, ḥima ad yarweř, uca inna i Axazya: “Tamenziwt, Axazya!”
Maca Yahu imneɛ řqews nnes deg ufus uca iřqef Yuram s fřitca jar iɣaǧen nnes. Fřitca tesnuqqeb qaɛ uř nnes uca iwḍa netta deg ukarru nnes.

Xenni inna Yahu i Bidkar, aneɣraf nnes n řɛeskar: “Ksi t uca nḍar i-t di tesɣart n yeyyar n Nabut, Ayazraɛili. Ɛqeř, necc d cek, ijj ɣar uɣezdis n wenneɣni, aqa nedhen x ikarruten nneɣ awarni i babas Axab umi xas icetca SIDI ammu, inna:
‘S tidett am ẓriɣ iḍennaḍ idammen n Nabut d iḥenjiren nnes, iqqar SIDI, ammu i zzayek ten ɣa xeřfeɣ x yeyyar-a, issawař SIDI.’ Xenni řexxu, ksi t uca nḍar i-t deg iyyar ɛlaḥsab awař n SIDI.”

Umi Axazya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, iẓra aya, iṭṭef abrid ɣar Bayt-Hagan. Yahu iḍfar i-t u řami yiweḍ ɣar teysart n Jur nni iǧan ɣar Jibliɛam, inna: “Wwet i-t uřa d netta x ukarru!” Xenni yarweř netta ɣar Majiddu uca immut din.
Imsexxaren nnes iwyen t x ukarru ɣar Urcalim uca neḍřen t deg wenḍeř nnes jar řejdud nnes di tendint n Dawud.
Deg useggʷas wiss ḥiṭac n Yuram, mmis n Axab, tuɣa idweř Axazya d ajeǧid x Yahuda.
Xenni yusa-dd Yahu ɣar Yazraɛil. Řami tt tesřa Izabil, tkeḥḥeř tiṭṭawin nnes, tzewweq acuwwaf nnes uca texzar zi řkazi ɣar swadday.
Umi dd-yudef Yahu zi tawwart, tenna: “Ma d řehna i xef dd-tusid, Zimri, a cek wenni inɣin sidis?”
Netta ixzar ɣar řkazi sennej, inna: “Wi akidi iǧan? Man Wen?” Xenni xzaren tnayen niɣ třata n imsexxaren icennɛen ɣares din swadday.
Netta inna asen: “Nḍarem tt-i-dd swadday!” Nitni nḍaren-tt-i-dd swadday ařami idammen nnes ttwaruccen x řḥiḍ u x yeysan, u netta iřbez i-tt.
Netta yudef uca icca, iswa. Awarni uya inna: “Xzarem ɣar tmexziwt nni u neḍřem tt, maɣar nettat d yeǧis n ujeǧid.”
Nitni uyuren, ḥima ad tt neḍřen, maca nitni war tt ufin ca mɣir taceqquft n uzeǧif d iḍaren d ifassen waha.
Umi dd-ɛeqben, ɛawden as t u netta yarra-dd: “Wa d awař n SIDI nni issiwiř s uqemmum n umsexxar nnes, Ilicaɛ Aticbi. Netta inna: ‘X yeyyar n Yazraɛil iṭan ad ccen aysum n řxecbet n Izabil.
Řxecbet n Izabil ad tiři am řeɣbar x yeyyar deg weḥwic n Yazraɛil, ař ɣa taf war din wi ɣa inin: Ta d Izabil.’”
